blurb:
This full-day adventure begins with convenient pick-up from Calgary(7:15am), Canmore(8:40am), or Banff(9:00am). 

Start in Banff, a charming mountain town surrounded by snow-draped peaks and filled with cozy shops and vibrant cafes. Wander its picturesque streets and soak in the breathtaking views.

Next, embark on a thrilling icewalk through Johnston Canyon. As you navigate frozen trails, you’ll be captivated by the towering ice formations and frozen waterfalls that create a magical, otherworldly atmosphere. 

Finally, venture to Marble Canyon, where the turquoise waters of the Tokumm Creek contrast beautifully with the snow-covered canyon walls. In winter, this tranquil spot becomes a wonderland of ice and snow, offering a peaceful and awe-inspiring experience that will leave you in awe.

Book your adventure today and create memories that will last a lifetime!
